_doc: Single source of truth for the established Juro design-system identity. The package scope, CSS custom-property prefix and data-attribute prefix are one coordinated contract. Rebranding is an explicit migration, not a setup command; see ADR 0011.
name: juro

_names._note: Read these descriptions against the configured values above. Verification keeps their projections aligned where the identity is repeated.
_names.name: Human/short name of the system. Used in generated headings.
_names.scope: npm scope for the workspace packages — the library resolves as <scope>/react and <scope>/tokens.
_names.tokenPrefix: CSS custom-property namespace: every property is --<tokenPrefix>-*. Every custom property the system declares or reads must carry it, so a bare --spacing cannot inherit into a consumer's markup and collide with a property of theirs by the same name.
_names.dataPrefix: Data-attribute namespace for component anatomy: data-<dataPrefix>-part and data-<dataPrefix>-state. Namespaced for the same reason as tokenPrefix — an unprefixed data-part can collide with a consumer's own.
